name: Afterpay/Clearpay API
tagline: Buy now, pay later checkout and payment APIs for merchants
description: Afterpay (Clearpay in the UK/EU) provides merchant APIs for buy-now-pay-later checkout, payment authorisation, order capture/refunds, and related e-commerce flows. Merchants integrate via server-side REST endpoints using merchant credentials; documentation covers Online API, Express Checkout, and platform-specific SDKs.
use_cases: create Afterpay checkout session for an order
capture or refund an Afterpay payment
